blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — Residents of Bagulin, La Union, who are forced to flee rising floodwaters and landslides during the rainy and typhoon seasons, will soon have a safer refuge as the municipality broke ground on Tuesday (Nov. 10) for the first Ligtas Pinoy Center (LPC) in the Ilocos Region in Barangay Suyo. Construction is expected to begin this month, with completion targeted in 2027. The project has a budget of P71.64 million, funded under the General Appropriations Act. The facility will include a healthcare station, sleeping quarters, sanitation facilities, and a designated area for livestock and pets to provide essential services […]...
